description: Source code for Kubernetes DeploymentController's recreate deployment strategy, including functions for rolling out, scaling down old replica sets, checking for running old pods, and scaling up new replica sets.

classes.name: DeploymentController
classes.description: Controller managing deployment rollouts with recreate strategy.

methods.name: rolloutRecreate
methods.description: Implements the recreate deployment rollout process, scaling down old replica sets, creating and scaling up new replica set, and updating deployment status.

methods.name: scaleDownOldReplicaSetsForRecreate
methods.description: Scales down all old replica sets to zero when using recreate deployment strategy.

methods.name: oldPodsRunning
methods.description: Checks if there are any old pods still running or in non-terminal states.

methods.name: scaleUpNewReplicaSetForRecreate
methods.description: Scales up the new replica set to the desired number of replicas.
